tools.name: list_upcoming_runs
tools.title: List upcoming runs
tools.description: List upcoming published grytclub group runs (title, date, start time, location, distance, pace, host). Returns runs scheduled today or later, soonest first.

tools.name: list_challenges
tools.title: List challenges
tools.description: List published grytclub challenges (title, tagline, target, dates). Optionally filter to those active today.

active_only.description: Only return challenges active today (default false).

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.title: Recent community activity
tools.description: Latest public grytclub community activity: challenge step completions and event check-ins by public members. Returns display name, first name, activity kind (completion or checkin), the related run/challenge title, and when it happened.
